examples.arabic: سألها جون عن قواعد الصيام خلال شهر رمضان.
examples.english: John asked her about the rules of fasting during the month of Ramadan.
examples.transliteration: Saalaha jun an qawaid alsiyam khilal shahr ramadan.

examples.arabic: قررت ان اطلب فنجان قهوة لاشربها خلال هذا الانتظار الطويل.
examples.english: I decided to order a cup of coffee to drink during this long wait.
examples.transliteration: Qarrartu an aṭluba finjāna qahwatin li-ashrabahā khilāla hādhā al-intizāri al-ṭawīli.
